**How to submit:** Upload your video file and your answers (a document or a clear photo) to the university e-learning platform. Due: **before lecture 23**.

## Task 1 · The promo (3 marks)

Finish the promo you started in the seminar (your own game, a free game you
recorded, or the clips of Timeline Lab).

a) Export it as `yourname-promo-v2.mp4`: H.264 in MP4, 25–30 seconds, the
right shape for a store page. (1 mark)

b) It has a hook in the first 3 seconds, short gameplay shots, and ends with
the name of the game and a call to action. (1 mark)

c) All titles are honest and inside the title safe area; the music is
allowed for you to use, and it ends with the picture. (1 mark)
